name: BioSignals
summary:
BioSignals for Meta Quest is a professional immersive biofeedback training application designed to bring physiological awareness, relaxation training, and emotional self-regulation into virtual reality.

The app works with compatible BioSignals sensors to display real-time body responses such as heart activity, heart-rate variability, skin conductance, breathing patterns, and stress-related changes.
